layers.label: Geological units (2011 map)
layers.description: Geological Map of Nigeria (2011): topologically clean polygon coverage (no gaps/overlaps). Source CRS unknown; georeferenced to EPSG:4326 from the 1-degree graticule (verified against national extents).

layers.label: Mineral occurrences (2023 map)
layers.description: Mineral Resources Map of Nigeria (2023): occurrence points hand-picked at every mineral symbol on the sheet. Each point is re-centered on its raster symbol where a one-to-one template match was certain; points in ambiguous symbol clusters keep their as-digitized position. match_class records which case applied.

layers.label: Geology map picture (2011)
layers.description: Geology Map of Nigeria (2011) map frame, georeferenced EPSG:4326, JPEG q75 tile pyramid (z0-z4)

layers.label: Mineral map picture (2023)
layers.description: Mineral Resources Map of Nigeria (2023) map frame, georeferenced EPSG:4326 (incl. +0.175 deg lon registration), JPEG q75 tile pyramid (z0-z4)

layers.label: Elevation / DEM (SRTM + Copernicus, AWS Terrain Tiles)
layers.description: DEM of Nigeria from AWS Terrain Tiles (Mapzen Terrarium: SRTM 30 m with Copernicus/other fill), sampled at zoom 9 and resampled to 0.025 deg. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Mean annual temperature (WorldClim 2.1)
layers.description: Mean annual temperature 1970-2000 (mean of the 12 WorldClim 2.1 10 arc-minute monthly tavg grids). Fick & Hijmans 2017. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Total annual precipitation (WorldClim 2.1)
layers.description: Total annual precipitation 1970-2000 (sum of the 12 WorldClim 2.1 10 arc-minute monthly prec grids). Fick & Hijmans 2017. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Mean annual solar radiation (WorldClim 2.1)
layers.description: Mean annual solar radiation 1970-2000 (mean of the 12 WorldClim 2.1 10 arc-minute monthly srad grids). Fick & Hijmans 2017. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Soil pH 0–5 cm (ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0)
layers.description: Soil pH (water) at 0-5 cm, ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0 mean prediction, divided by 10 from the WCS phh2o_0-5cm_mean coverage. Poggio et al. 2021, CC BY 4.0. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Settlement extents (GRID3 v3.1)
layers.description: GRID3 NGA Settlement Extents v3.1 (CIESIN/Columbia, CC BY-SA 4.0), largest 12,000 settlement polygons by building area, generalised to 0.0015 deg. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Built-up surface 2020 (GHSL)
layers.description: JRC Global Human Settlement Layer GHS-BUILT-S, epoch 2020, R2023A, 30 arc-second built-up surface (square metres) resampled to 0.025 degree. CC BY 4.0. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: River basins (FAO / HydroSHEDS)
layers.description: FAO AQUASTAT hydrological basins in Africa (derived from HydroSHEDS 15 arc-second drainage), clipped to Nigeria and simplified. 1450 Africa-wide sub-basins; fields sub_bas, maj_bas, sub_name, maj_name, sub_area. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Flood hazard: 100-year riverine depth (Aqueduct)
layers.description: WRI Aqueduct Floods v2 baseline riverine inundation depth (metres) for the 1-in-100-year return period, 30 arc-second; maximum depth per 0.025 degree cell, zero where no inundation is modelled. Winsemius et al. / WRI. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Gridded population ~1 km (WorldPop v3.0)
layers.description: WorldPop Nigeria v3.0 (2025) bottom-up gridded population, 3 arc-second (~100 m) counts summed to a 0.0089 degree (~1 km) grid. CC BY 4.0. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Airports (OSM)
layers.description: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team Nigeria airports country export (HDX, ODbL), 1571 features, clipped to Nigeria. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Sea ports (OSM)
layers.description: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team Nigeria sea_ports country export (HDX, ODbL), 451 features, clipped to Nigeria. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Points of interest (OSM)
layers.description: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team Nigeria points_of_interest country export (HDX, ODbL), 60490 features, clipped to Nigeria. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Aquifer units & productivity (BGS 2019)
layers.description: BGS Africa Groundwater Atlas country hydrogeology map for Nigeria, Version 1.0 (2019/2021), 1:5,000,000. Each polygon carries both the hydrogeologically significant geology unit and the aquifer type / productivity class (CSI, I, B, U ... codes, see user guide OR/21/063). CC BY-SA 4.0. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Hydrogeological units, ECOWAS (WHYMAP 2022)
layers.description: Groundwater Resources in the ECOWAS Region (BGR/BGS/BRGM/Eawag/UNESCO 2022), 1:5,000,000, vector dataset GWR_ECOWAS_SHP_v1. Hydrogeological units with stratigraphy, basin, lithology, aquifer flow type, expected borehole yield and productivity class; harmonised with Nigeria linework from Dessauvagie (1974). Clipped to Nigeria. doi 10.25928/GWR-ECOWAS.1. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Superficial cover aquifers, ECOWAS (WHYMAP 2022)
layers.description: Groundwater Resources in the ECOWAS Region (2022) superficial cover layer: Quaternary alluvial, aeolian and lacustrine deposits overlying bedrock aquifers, with aquifer flow type and expected borehole yield. Nine region-wide units, clipped to Nigeria. doi 10.25928/GWR-ECOWAS.1. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Water points & boreholes (WPDx)
layers.description: Water Point Data Exchange (WPDx) Nigeria water points, HDX enhanced CSV (CC BY-SA 4.0). Boreholes, protected wells, springs and piped sources with technology, functionality status and administrative area. Observed points, not modelled groundwater. Clipped to Nigeria. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Transboundary aquifers (IGRAC 2025)
layers.description: IGRAC & UNESCO-IHP Transboundary Aquifers of the World, Edition 2025 (CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO; doi 10.58154/yb8g-cp97), via the GGIS GeoServer WFS layer geonode:tba_map_2025. Shared aquifer systems intersecting Nigeria including Lake Chad, Iullemmeden, Benue and Rio del Rey. Clipped to the Nigeria map window. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Water table depth (Fan et al. 2017)
layers.description: Revised Fan et al. (2017) equilibrium water table depth, 0.01 degree (~1 km) Africa annual-mean NetCDF, averaged to a 0.0125 degree grid and masked to Nigeria. Depth in metres below the land surface (source stores negative depth). Free for research with acknowledgement of Fan et al. 2017, PNAS 114(40):10572-10577. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Magnetic anomaly (EMAG2 v2)
layers.description: EMAG2 Earth Magnetic Anomaly Grid v2, 2 arc-minute global total-field anomaly in nT (NOAA/NCEI / CIRES, free). Averaged to 0.025 degree and masked to Nigeria. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Landslide hazard: rainfall-triggered frequency (World Bank)
layers.description: World Bank / GFDRR Global Landslide Hazard Map (Arup, 2020), median annual frequency of significant rainfall-triggered landslides per square kilometre, 1980-2018, 30 arc-second COG averaged to 0.025 degree and masked to Nigeria. CC BY 4.0. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Landslide hazard classes (World Bank / ThinkHazard)
layers.description: World Bank / GFDRR Global Landslide Hazard Map (Arup, 2020), combined rainfall- and earthquake-triggered hazard simplified to four ThinkHazard ranks (1 Very low, 2 Low, 3 Moderate, 4 High). The 30 arc-second LS_TH.tif raster was clipped to the Nigeria outline and polygonised into contiguous class regions; tiny regions removed and boundaries simplified to 0.002 degree. CC BY 4.0. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Geothermal heat flow measurements (IHFC 2024)
layers.description: International Heat Flow Commission Global Heat Flow Database, Release 2024 (91,182 measurements, doi 10.5880/fidgeo.2024.014). Observed terrestrial heat flow q in mW/m2 with uncertainty, temperature gradient, environment, quality code and publication reference. Points inside the Nigeria map window, including nearby cross-border sites. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Admin boundaries (map2011)
layers.description: Geological map: state/international boundary casing lines

layers.label: Background (map2023)
layers.description: Mineral map: generalised geology classes read from the raster fills (no gaps/overlaps; clipped to national land mask).

layers.label: Faults (map2011)
layers.description: Geological map: faults and fractures

layers.label: General (picture)
layers.description: General geology (simplified, 9 era classes) - picture georeferenced to EPSG:4326, clipped to the drawn country (title, legend, scale bar and neighbours transparent); PNG RGBA tiles z0-z2

layers.label: General (picture)
layers.description: General (small-scale) geology of Nigeria digitised from general-geology-map-of-nigeria.png (615x715 px, ~2.5 km/px) into 8 colour classes of its legend. Quaternary alluvium and Mesozoic sediments share one pale-yellow legend colour on the picture and cannot be separated by colour, so they are ONE class here (the detailed 2011 geology layer geology_units_map2011_pg separates them). Rivers, dotted lines and place markers on the sheet are absorbed into the surrounding class. Georeferenced by outline fit to the geology land mask. Compare with the detailed layer geology_units_map2011_pg for accuracy.

layers.label: General code (picture)
layers.description: General geology class code (1-8, order of geology_general_picture_pg). Categorical single band; see meta_picture_value_legend_tbl. Derived by rasterising the vector layer geology_general_picture_pg at 0.005 deg. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Ridges (map2011)
layers.description: Geological map: ridges

layers.label: Surficial (USGS)
layers.description: Surficial geology of Nigeria from the supplied USGS shapefile geo7_2ag (Persits et al., Geology, Oil and Gas Fields, and Geologic Provinces of Africa, OFR 97-470-A, 2002; small scale, Africa-wide). Clipped to the GADM national outline and dissolved by unit (glg_code), on a 0.002 deg (about 220 m) grid. Original polygon ids, area and perimeter columns dropped; area_km2 recomputed. EPSG:4326. Codes Kl, H2O and SEA are labelled by us (they are missing from the metadata list of the source).

layers.label: Surficial code (USGS)
layers.description: Single-band geology unit code of the USGS surficial geology (geology_surficial_usgs_pg), 1..n in alphabetical order of glg_code; see geology_surficial_usgs_legend_tbl. Rasterised at 0.005 deg, outside Nigeria = NoData. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Unit boundaries (map2011)
layers.description: Geological map: geological boundaries (lines between units; exact/approximate/inferred/transitional share the same stroke family in the source)

layers.label: Division lines (map2023)
layers.description: Mineral map: division lines separating zones A-G

layers.label: Unresolved symbols (map2023)
layers.description: QA layer: leftover symbol fragments that could not be given a confirmed mineral name.
